name: business-central-mcp-server
description: Query and manage Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP data through the standard v2.0 and custom AL APIs.
long_description:
Reads Business Central over its OData APIs: environments, companies, entity sets, filtered queries, and single records. Read-only by default. Write mode adds create, update, bound actions such as posting a document, and binary export of invoice PDFs and attachments. Deletion is a separate opt-in and requires a two-step plan/apply confirmation.

Sign-in uses your own Entra account through an interactive browser prompt, so the server acts as you and inherits your Business Central permission sets. A service principal is also supported for non-interactive use.

tenant_id.title: Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: The GUID of the Microsoft Entra tenant your Business Central lives in. Find it in the Entra admin center under Overview.

auth_mode.title: Sign-in method
auth_mode.description: interactive opens a browser and signs you in as yourself (recommended). service-principal is non-interactive and needs the client ID and secret below. cli and azure-powershell reuse an existing az login or Connect-AzAccount session and require those tools installed.

mode.title: Server mode
mode.description: read exposes only the query tools. write also exposes create, update, bound actions, and file export, which change real ERP data.

allow_delete.title: Allow record deletion
allow_delete.description: Exposes delete_entity, which permanently removes records. Requires write mode and is ignored without it. Deletion is always two-step: a dry run returns what would be removed plus a confirmation token.

environment.title: Default environment
environment.description: Optional. Environment used when a tool call omits one, for example Production or a sandbox name. Leave blank to pass it explicitly every time.

company_id.title: Default company ID
company_id.description: Optional. Company GUID used when a tool call omits one. Discover it with the list_companies tool.

export_dir.title: Export folder
export_dir.description: Where export_file saves invoice PDFs, attachments, and pictures. Pick a folder you can write to.

item_attr_api_route.title: Item attribute API route
item_attr_api_route.description: Optional. Custom AL API route (publisher/group/version) that publishes itemAttributes, itemAttributeValues, and itemAttributeValueMappings, used by set_item_attribute when a call omits api_route. The standard v2.0 API does not expose item attributes.

client_id.title: Application (client) ID
client_id.description: Required only for service-principal sign-in. Leave blank for interactive, which falls back to the public Azure CLI client.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Required only for service-principal sign-in. Stored by the operating system's credential manager.

scope.title: Token scope (advanced)
scope.description: Leave blank unless you are on a sovereign cloud. Defaults to https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/.default

api_base.title: API base URL (advanced)
api_base.description: Leave blank unless you are on a sovereign cloud or an embedded ISV deployment. Defaults to https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List the production and sandbox environments in the tenant

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List the companies in an environment

tools.name: list_entity_sets
tools.description: List the entity sets available on an API route

tools.name: query_entities
tools.description: Query an entity set with OData filter, select, orderby, and expand

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get a single record by id, including its etag

tools.name: export_file
tools.description: Save a Business Central document, attachment, or picture to a local file

tools.name: create_entity
tools.description: Create a record. Changes real ERP data

tools.name: update_entity
tools.description: Update a record with etag concurrency. Changes real ERP data

tools.name: set_item_attribute
tools.description: Set an item attribute by name and value, two-step plan/apply. Changes real ERP data

tools.name: invoke_bound_action
tools.description: Invoke a bound action such as posting a document. Changes real ERP data

tools.name: delete_entity
tools.description: Permanently delete a record, behind a two-step confirmation
